description: Retrieve client-encrypted memory entries for an entity. Returns ciphertext, nonce, and content_hash - never plaintext. Requires wallet signature. Compliance: GDPR Art. 15, 32. Cost $0.01 per call.

category.description: Optional category filter. Omit to return every category the caller may read.

entity_id.description: Stable identifier of the entity whose encrypted memory should be returned.

owner_wallet.description: Optional owner address. Required (and must match signer) for owner self-read.

signer_wallet.description: 0x-prefixed address of the caller. Owner path when it matches owner_wallet.

wallet_signature.description: EIP-191 signature over the deterministic read message (owner or grantee role).

name: memory.read

outputSchema.description: Encrypted memory entries the caller is allowed to read.

ok.description: True when the tool completed without a validation error.

payment.description: Settlement receipt after x402 or sandbox payment.

tool.description: Tool name that produced this payload.

title: Memory Read
